thread:
claire: Experiment idea: add a 'cost provenance' timeline to the console's per-tenant view that shows how a token's cost flowed across routes/models over time. PR sketch: https://git.redwood/infra/console/pulls/688. Thoughts?

vikram: interesting. will help debug weird spikes. how granular is the timeline? per-token, per-invocation, or per-batch?

claire: default is per-invocation with an optional drilldown to per-token (off by default). timeline rows: router -> model_variant -> cache_hit -> fallback. each hop shows an estimated token delta and a confidence score.

june: UX: we should avoid overloading users. show a compact "sparkline" lane and allow expanding a single invocation. add a mini-legend: green = cache saved, orange = reroute delta, grey = estimated.

carla: backend constraints: we don't want to increase storage cardinality. proposal: store lightweight provenance as an encoded array of hop enums + counts, not full trace ids. compress to base64 and only retain for 7 days.

metrics-bot: note: adding per-invocation provenance increases metric cardinality. suggest emitting aggregate histograms instead of per-tenant per-invocation tags.

vikram: another idea: compute a per-route "shared-kv score" via a small bloom filter sketch per hour. can infer likely shared prefetches without storing full lineage. helps with attribution without creating per-invocation keys.

claire: I like the bloom sketch approach. we can display a "shared-kv confidence" bar on the timeline. If confidence is low, show a warning: "low provenance confidence: results estimated from sketches".

june: copy suggestion for warning: "Estimated trace — low confidence due to sampling. Use debug mode to capture full provenance for 24h." keeps expectations clear.

carla: API change request: console API should return fields: provenance_blob (optional, base64), provenance_confidence (0-1), token_equiv, usd_equiv_used_at. keep names stable.

vikram: on sampling: current sample-rate defaults make per-invocation timelines choppy for small tenants. propose an adaptive smoothing layer: if sample_rate < 2% then apply an exponential smoothing over 1h window to stabilize microcosts in the UI. call it cost_smoothing_window=1h.

marc: alerting POV: smoothing hides immediate regressions. alert rules should run on raw unsmoothed signals, UI shows smoothed values. add metric: token_provenance_confidence_bucketed{tenant,window}.

claire: good call. we'll decouple display smoothing vs alerting. UI param: "Show smoothed costs (recommended for low-volume tenants)" default on for <500 calls/day.

june: visualize smoothing toggle in the card settings. also show the smoothing window and algorithm (exp smoothing alpha). transparency reduces support tickets.

carla: implementation note: provenance_blob emission should be opt-in per-tenant via feature flag to avoid costs. Admin endpoint: POST /admin/tenants/:id/feature_flags {"provenance_debug": true}.

vikram: to keep cardinality low, provenance_confidence should be a 0-100 integer bucket. no freeform floats in tags.

marc: rollout plan: stage -> 5% prod with feature_flag on for internal tenants -> 25% -> 100% over 72h. monitoring: median token delta, 95p latency, provenance_blob ingestion error rate. kill switch: feature flag + toggle in deployment.

metrics-bot: job queued: infra.jobs.recompute_smoothing_params for adaptive thresholds at 02:00 UTC.

claire: action items: carla wire up compressed provenance API; vikram add bloom sketch producer & confidence metric; june finalize UI mock + copy; marc create alert runbook. I'll update the PR with these todos. ping me after staging deploy. :sparkles:
